crossRefs.note: Before I was afflicted, I went astray; but now I observe your word.
It is good for me that I have been afflicted, that I may learn your statutes.
“Behold, happy is the man whom God corrects. Therefore do not despise the chastening of the Almighty.
My son, don’t despise Yahweh’s discipline, neither be weary of his correction;
But when we are judged, we are punished by the Lord, that we may not be condemned with the world.
You have forgotten the exhortation which reasons with you as with children, “My son, don’t take lightly the chastening…
Then he opens the ears of men, and seals their instruction,
Yahweh’s voice calls to the city, and wisdom sees your name: “Listen to the rod, and he who appointed it.
As many as I love, I reprove and chasten. Be zealous therefore, and repent.

translations.web: Blessed is the man whom you discipline, Yah, and teach out of your law,
translations.bsb: Blessed is the man You discipline, O LORD, and teach from Your law,
translations.kjv: Blessed is the man whom thou chastenest, O LORD, and teachest him out of thy law;
translations.asv: Blessed is the man whom thou chastenest, O Jehovah, And teachest out of thy law;
